## Merge Strategy
- Only squash merge is allowed
- Direct push to develop is restricted

## Pull Request Rules
- PR title must include issue number (#123)
- At least 1 approval required (Architect)

## Co-authorship
If multiple developers worked:

Co-authored-by: Name <email>
Example:
Co-authored-by: Peter Selva <peterselva.p@icanio.com>


This must be included in the final squash commit message.

## Checklist
- [ ] PR title includes issue number
- [ ] Co-authors added (if applicable)
- [ ] Code reviewed
